'''Tannon Praji''' was a [[human]] who served as the [[First Minister (Coruscant Ministry of Ingress)|First Minister]] of the [[Coruscant Ministry of Ingress]],<ref name="Insider" /> a body that handled the flow of immigrants on to the [[Galactic Republic]] [[capital]] of [[Coruscant]].<ref name="CL" /> In [[19 BBY]],<ref name="GA">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates the events of {{Film|III}} to [[19 BBY]].</ref> Praji attended a performance<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref> of the [[Mon Calamari]] ballet ''[[Squid Lake]]'' at the [[Galaxies Opera House]] on Coruscant.<ref name="USW">''[[Ultimate Star Wars]]''</ref>

The minister wore [[Color|black]] [[Clothing|robes]] and a gold-colored headpiece to the performance and was walking past the entrance to the opera house with another human as the [[Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker]] ran up the building's stairs. During the performance, Praji then sat with five other humans in a box beside the box where [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]] was seated.<ref name="ROTS" /> Praji had light skin, black [[hair]], and brown [[eye]]s. The minister shared a surname<ref name="Insider" /> with the [[Imperial officer]] [[Commander]] [[Praji]]<ref name="Encyclopedia">{{EncyclopediaCite|The Rise of the Rebellion and the Battle of Yavin}}</ref> and the wealthy [[House Praji]] of the [[Core Worlds]].<ref name="KoF">''[[Knights of Fate]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Tannon Praji appeared in the [[prequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']],<ref name="ROTS" /> which was released on [[May 19]], [[2005]].<ref name="YbY">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, New Edition]]''</ref> The character was a cameo portrayed by visual effects supervisor [[John Knoll]], who had previously appeared as the character [[Irya Kirsch]] in the [[1999]] prequel film, [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']].<ref name="Insider" />

In the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], Tannon Praji was identified in "[[Pushing Boundaries]]," an interview with Knoll conducted by [[Brandon Wainerdi]] and published in [[Star Wars Insider 217|''Star Wars Insider'' 217]]<ref name="Insider" /> on [[March 14]], [[2023]].<ref name="Titan">{{TitanComics|url=insider/subscriptions|text=Star Wars Insider Subscription Information}}</ref> The name originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, where it was created by [[Zack Bossan]] as part of the [[Tannon Praji/Legends|character's]] backstory through [[StarWars.com]]'s [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] feature "[[What's The Story?]],"<ref name="DB">{{DB|character|tannonpraji|Praji, Tannon}}</ref> which was published on [[August 12]], 2005.<ref name="Round1">{{SWArchive|url=databank/updates/news20050812.html|text=Hyperspace Presents: What's the Story, Round 1}}</ref>
